context:
Goal: q_max's test helper skip-locally-fail-in-ci.mjs comes from claude-settings by pointer, with no copy (goal item 5, shared tooling by pointer).
Problem (rule): q_max PR #1185 (branch qmax-skip-locally-pointer) replaces the copy with a pointer. It needs a claude-settings checkout, so a q_max test run with no checkout fails loudly and names each place it looked. It never skips. This changes how every q_max test run starts, so it needs your word. CI is unaffected: each test shard already sets CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR.
Based on (ruling): claude-settings decision uniform-over-variants says a repo changes to fit the shared file.
Based on (read): runner 12, relayed by the coordinator at 06:43 CST Nov 16 (triage read no diff): the two copies are byte-identical in code, and only the header comments differ (PR #1185 body, "Diff of the two copies first"). q_max's own copy of the test and its timing entry in harness/run-tests.mjs are deleted, because the shared test lives in claude-settings.
Departs from: main has a q_max-owned copy of the helper that runs with no claude-settings checkout. #1185 has q_max tests import the shared file, so a local run with no checkout fails with a clear error.
Meanwhile: #1185 is blocked on billing (page item 916) and stays draft. Runner 12 keeps merging other lanes and does not merge #1185 until you answer.

options.gain: One home for the helper, no drift, and it matches your ruling.
options.how: q_max tests import the shared helper from a claude-settings checkout. With no checkout, a test run fails and names each place it looked.
options.label: Pointer, loud failure with no checkout
options.lose: A q_max test run with no claude-settings checkout fails until one is cloned or CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR is set.

options.gain: q_max tests run with no checkout.
options.how: q_max keeps its own copy and a check refuses it when it differs from the shared file.
options.label: Keep the copy and add a match check
options.lose: Still a copy and a second form. It goes against your ruling that a repo changes to fit the shared file.

options.gain: A local run with no checkout does not fail.
options.how: Pointer as in A, but the helper's tests skip when no checkout exists.
options.label: Pointer, and skip the helper's tests with no checkout
options.lose: A silent skip hides the helper in CI, which is the failure the helper exists to prevent.

reply: You asked for the pros and cons of a claude-settings checkout existing for q_max tests (read from this item and runner 12's relay; not measured). Pros: one home for the helper and no drift; it matches your ruling that a repo changes to fit the shared file; CI is unaffected, because each shard already sets CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR. Cons: a local q_max test run with no checkout fails until one is cloned or CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR is set, and q_max tests now depend on a folder in another repo. Unmeasured: how often a q_max local run has no checkout. Options a, b and c are unchanged; the item stays open for your pick.

title: q_max tests would import the shared skip-locally helper by pointer: fail loudly with no checkout, keep a checked copy, or skip silently?
why: Runner 12 recommends A: it matches uniform-over-variants and loses only a local run with no checkout. It is runner 12's ask, relayed by the coordinator, not owner-typed.
